reduce_masked_tensor_sum: reduce a masked tensor by summing its values while respecting the mask
reduce_masked_tensor_mean: reduce a masked tensor by computing the mean while ignoring masked elements
reduce_masked_tensor_argmin_argmax: reduce a masked tensor to find the argmin or argmax index respecting the mask
reduce_masked_tensor_amin_amax: reduce a masked tensor to find the minimum or maximum value while respecting the mask
apply_reduction_dispatch: apply a reduction operation to a masked tensor by dispatching through native torch or tensor method maps
